item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 12/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The weather will be hot and the visibility will be relatively low over Guangdong today and tomorrow. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Thursday, it will be windier in the following couple of days, temperatures will be lower during the day. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect the coastal areas of Guangdong and bring relatively cool weather to the region early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Megi will linger over the eastern part of the Philippines and weaken gradually today and tomorrow. Tropical Cyclone Malakas will move across the western North Pacific and towards the seas south of Japan in the next couple of days.
